latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Food Photography Generator skill.
- Generate professional AI food photography for various culinary needs (menus, recipe cards, blogs, branding, editorial content, and more) using the Neta AI image generation API.
- Supports customizable image size options (`portrait`, `landscape`, `square`, `tall`) and style inheritance via reference images.
- Requires a Neta API token for use; free trial available.
- Simple Bash-based usage with quick start instructions provided.
